about: Validation for the Nov 16, 2026 touching fix (prompt rule plus backstop patterns). Written after the fix and before any run, worded unlike both the patterns and concerns-touching.json, so it shows whether the fix generalizes rather than whether it memorized. Six unwanted-touching concerns and four everyday ones.

concerns.subject: Coach keeps patting my thigh
concerns.body: My varsity coach keeps patting my thigh whenever he talks to me after training. I tried sitting farther away but he moves closer.

concerns.subject: Man on the LRT near campus
concerns.body: A man in a TUP lanyard pressed himself against me on the LRT from Pedro Gil all the way to Recto, even though there was space. I saw him again at the gate today.

concerns.subject: Palaging inaakbayan ng prof
concerns.body: Yung prof po namin palagi akong inaakbayan at hinihila papalapit sa kanya kahit umiiwas na ako. Nangyayari po ito tuwing consultation.

concerns.subject: Hinalikan nang walang paalam
concerns.body: Hinalikan po ako sa pisngi ng isang kaklase nang walang paalam habang nasa canteen kami, tapos pinagtawanan pa ako ng barkada niya.

concerns.subject: Teacher would not let go of my hand
concerns.body: During our field trip, a teacher kept holding my hand and would not let go when I tried to pull away. He did it again on the bus back.

concerns.subject: Pulled toward the stairwell
concerns.body: Someone I don't know grabbed my bag strap and pulled me toward the empty stairwell of the Engineering building. I got away and ran to the guard.

concerns.subject: New faucets
concerns.body: The new touch-free faucets in the second-floor comfort room are great. Thank you to whoever installed them!

concerns.subject: Excuse letter for PE
concerns.body: I hurt my back during PE class last Friday and my doctor told me to rest. How can I get an excuse letter for this week's activities?

concerns.subject: Hug sa stage
concerns.body: Tanong lang po: pwede po bang mag-hug ang graduates sa stage kasama ang parents nila? Para lang po sa program namin.

concerns.subject: Classmate keeps kicking my chair
concerns.body: A classmate keeps kicking my chair and shoving his desk into mine during lectures to annoy me. It has gone on for weeks and the professor ignores it.
